raw_text:
IDOR via API Parameter Tampering - Invoice Access

IDOR vulnerability in /api/invoices/{invoice_id} endpoint.
User can modify invoice_id parameter to access other users' invoices.

Successful exploitation demonstrated:
Original request: GET /api/invoices/1001
Tampered request: GET /api/invoices/1002 (different user's invoice)
Response: 200 OK with another user's financial data

Exposed customer information:
Customer email: customer.john@acmecorp.com
Billing email: billing@gmail.com
AWS account ID pattern: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
Internal API endpoint: billing-api.staging.local
Testing performed from: 192.168.50.100
Captured authentication: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJjdXN0b21lciIsImludm9pY2VfaWQiOjEwMDJ9.xyz123abc
GCP service account: ya29.a0AfH6SMCw_BillingServiceAccount_example
API gateway key: sk_sk_test_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00001_BillingGatewayKey_123456789
Database host: invoice-db.internal
